## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Kaṇhadīpāyanacariya* (Cp 31) is a verse narrative in the *Cariyāpiṭaka* recounting a past life of the Bodhisatta as the ascetic Kaṇha-Dīpāyana [Bareau]. In this birth, he maintained the conduct of an ascetic for more than fifty years despite having no delight in the hermit life [Bareau].

A French translation and comparative study of the opening verse is provided by André Bareau [Bareau].
